an5.27:1.1: samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvetha appamāṇaṃ nipakā patissatā
an5.27:1.2: samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvayataṃ appamāṇaṃ nipakānaṃ patissatānaṃ pañca ñāṇāni paccattaññeva uppajjanti
an5.27:1.4: ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho ceva āyatiṃ ca sukhavipākoti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
an5.27:1.5: ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmisoti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
an5.27:1.6: ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevitoti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
an5.27:1.7: ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāvādhigato na ca sasaṃkhāraniggayhavāritappattoti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
an5.27:1.8: so kho panāhaṃ imaṃ samādhiṃ satova samāpajjāmi sato vuṭṭhahāmīti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
an5.27:2.1: samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvetha appamāṇaṃ nipakā patissatā
an5.27:2.2: samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvayataṃ appamāṇaṃ nipakānaṃ patissatānaṃ imāni pañca ñāṇāni paccattaññeva uppajjantīti.
